mapper.insert: insert into sys_export_task (handler_type, status, file_key, file_name, content_type, requested_by, query_snapshot, security_snapshot, total_count, processed_count, success_count, failure_count, create_time) values (#{handlerType}, #{status}, #{fileKey}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{requestedBy}, #{querySnapshot}, #{securitySnapshot}, #{totalCount}, #{processedCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update sys_export_task set status = 'RUNNING', started_time = #{startedTime}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until <= #{startedTime}))

update sys_export_task set total_count = #{total}, processed_count = #{processed}, success_count = #{success}, failure_count = #{failure}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and status = 'RUNNING'

update sys_export_task set status = #{status}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, lease_until = null, lease_token = null, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and status = 'RUNNING'

update sys_export_task set status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{message}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, lease_until = null, lease_token = null, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and status = 'RUNNING'

update sys_export_task set status = 'CANCELLED', finished_time = #{finishedTime}, lease_until = null, lease_token = null, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and status in ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')

update sys_export_task set status = case when status = 'PENDING' then 'CANCELLED' else 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' end, finished_time = case when status = 'PENDING' then sysdate() else finished_time end, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: select * from sys_export_task where status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until <= #{now}) order by create_time asc, task_id asc limit 100
